title: Pacific Brands Household Products Pty Ltd - acquisition of Foam Products Australia
acquirers: Pacific Brands Household Products Pty Ltd

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties
ACCC decided not to oppose the acquisition

body_sections.Market definition: The ACCC considered the acquisition in the Queensland market for the manufacture and conversion of flexible polyurethane slabstock foam.
body_sections.Competition analysis: The ACCC has previously reviewed matters in the foam industry.  This matter involved the acquisition of a foam manufacturing/conversion business with facilities in a single state.  The ACCC considered that the acquisition was unlikely to substantially lessen competition in the relevant market.  Among other things, the ACCC took into account the existence of two other foam manufacturers in Queensland, relatively low barriers to expansion, combined with low customer switching costs.
